definitions.full: H3463. yashen I. יָשֵׁן adjective sleeping ; — masculine singular יָשֵׁן 1Sam 26:7 3 t., feminine singular יֲשֵׁנֵה 1Kin 3:20 Cant 52; plural יְשֵׁנִים 1Sam 26:12 ; Song 7:10 ; construct יֲשֵׁנֵי Dan 12:2 ; — asleep, sleeping 1Sam 26:7 , 12 ; 1Kin 3:20 ; Song 5:2 ; 7:10 ; so, figurative, Hosea 7:6 , explained as = יֶעְשַׁן smoketh , compare Deut 29:19 , by RS J Phil. xvi. 1888, 72; Proph. iv. n. 19 Che with אַמְּהֶם (Ges § 1 . R. 1 a) for אֹפֵהֶם ; but < We, their anger sleepeth ; of Baal 1Kin 18:27 ; in simile of ׳י Psa 78:65 ; of dead, as sleeping in dust, Dan 12:2 .
